recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: an hour of speech distilled to thirteen seconds on a quiet laptop
enterprise browsers carving new territory for the workplace web
virtual companion platforms meeting the cold ledger
clear autumn night over san francisco, eleven degrees before dawn
agents spun up from a phone while the city still sleeps

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling autumn leaves before they smear a live transcription waveform — each leaf caught adds a syllable to a glowing sentence assembling in real time.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one perfect haiku assembled in under 60 seconds
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: wind gusts accelerate and leaves cluster in tighter spiral patterns
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform on fog-gray autumn night

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold and release to launch agent pods from phone shortcuts at the exact sunrise window — the sky gradient is your only clock.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nail three consecutive sunrise launch windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: incoming clouds narrow the golden release band each round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper-cutout shortcut icons against watercolor dawn

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe enterprise tabs and personal tabs into separate lanes before a bankruptcy timer erases the wrong pile forever.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clear a desk of 20 tabs before the ledger closes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: tabs spawn faster and decoy duplicates mimic real ones
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: flat corporate blue vs warm personal orange split screen

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one unbroken path through a maze of parallel agent brains — every fork must echo the others without crossing.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: link all four model nodes in a single continuous stroke
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: brains pulse and shrink the drawable corridor mid-stroke
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: wireframe neural graph on black with holographic 2026 palette
